title: Chapter 202 Two Landlubbers
content:
Chapter 202 Two Landlubbers

The two looked at each other, but there was no extra words.

Because bubbles kept coming out of their mouths.

As for the others, the situation was different.

Gong Zheng and Ayub were actually good at swimming. They endured all kinds of discomfort and swam out of the water to take a breath. When they didn't see Wang Shuo, they sank into the water again and searched for Wang Shuo.

The best situation was the yellow-haired Locke.

He came from a military family and received various military training since he was a child.

Underwater combat is naturally a basic skill. Not only is he an excellent swimmer, but he can also kill people underwater.

But he has never swam in this dead lake.

After a brief panic, he rushed out of the water. After hearing the prompt, he swam towards the rockery regardless of anything.

All the people here have no relatives or friends with him. He is considered to have a noble character if he doesn't secretly trip him up. How can he care about other people's lives?

Although Shi Lisha and Yinghua Guzi were not good at swimming, they could still swim to the surface to breathe.

At this time, only Wang Shuo and Ye Xueer were left, hugging each other tightly in the water.

Wang Shuo even had a terrible idea at a certain moment.

If he could just die like this, holding a beautiful woman, his life would not be in vain.

The two of them regarded each other as a lifeline, and this idea seemed ridiculous to others.

But what could they do?

Wang Shuo was also desperate!

During the violent struggle, Ye Xueer suddenly kissed Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo felt like he was electrocuted, and a flash of clarity flashed through his brain.

The whole world became quiet.

He suddenly thought that he still had a prop to use.

It was the "water-proof sky curtain" used to resist floods before.

He quickly took it out of his backpack, and he was ruthless and directly invested 100,000 energy crystals.

In an instant, a huge change occurred in the lake.

I saw a colorful light curtain spreading out from Wang Shuo and Ye Xueer, directly dispersing the water in the entire lake.

The area of the light curtain continued to expand until it exceeded the area of 3 lakes.

"Too much force."

Several people floating on the water fell directly, breaking countless dry bones.

Ye Xueer was also stunned by this change, and forgot to get off Wang Shuo for a while.

The two of them, just like this, listened to each other's heartbeats.

Wang Shuo held Ye Xueer's hips with one hand, and the other hand was suspended in the air. He didn't know whether he should hug Ye Xueer's waist, after all, his neck was still a little uncomfortable.

The two of them were nose to nose, and Wang Shuo seemed to smell a fragrance, and his mouth was dry for a while.

"Lord, are you okay!" Gong Zheng immediately ran over and shouted, breaking the quiet atmosphere.

Before Wang Shuo's right hand in the air, he hugged Ye Xueer's slender waist.

Ye Xueer jumped off Wang Shuo with a start, turned around and shook off the lake water on her body.

"Ah, I, I'm fine." Wang Shuo also came back to his senses.

In order to hide his embarrassment and vent his anger, Wang Shuo stared at the old witch Xia Qi fiercely.

"Old witch, now there is no lake water, I wonder how you can make trouble."

"Go, go up and kill her for me." Wang Shuo shouted, took out the flaming spear, and jumped onto the pavilion.

Fuck the swimming competition!

Xia Qi was also confused by this sudden change!

Where is the water?

There was no expression of surprise on her face, because her face could not support her to make such an expression.

Otherwise, a whole duck egg would definitely be stuffed into her mouth.
